title: Know the sharp tools
intro: Some tools can make gains bigger, and losses bigger too. This Lesson shows borrowing to invest and selling stock you do not own. It ends the Journey.

check.prompt: Your margin account falls below the firm's minimum, and you add no cash. What happens next?
check.explanation: The firm sells your investments. It does this to bring your equity back up.

check.prompt: When you sell a stock short, your losses have a limit.
check.explanation: Myth. A price can keep rising, so short-selling losses have no limit.

check.prompt: You sell short at $60, and the price rises to $80. What happens when you buy back?
check.explanation: You lose $20 a share. You must buy back at a higher price.
